scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.lint: bun run lint:frontend && bun run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:fix:frontend && bun run lint:fix:backend
scripts.type-check: bun run type-check:frontend && bun run type-check:backend
scripts.deps:reset: bun run deps:clean && bun run deps:install
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/dist frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules backend/dist backend/*.tsbuildinfo node_modules
scripts.clean:install: bun run clean && bun run install:all
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && bunx prisma db seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate reset --force && bunx prisma db seed
